querySql:
select 
                                      id,
                                      industry_code,
                                      industry_name,
                                      industry_level,
                                      index_code,
                                      con_date,
                                      con_year,
                                      revise_up_ratio_10d,
                                      revise_up_ratio_25d,
                                      revise_up_ratio_75d,
                                      revise_down_ratio_10d,
                                      revise_down_ratio_25d,
                                      revise_down_ratio_75d,
                                      revise_ratio_10d,
                                      revise_ratio_25d,
                                      revise_ratio_75d,
                                      entrytime,
                                      updatetime,
                                      tmstamp,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'zyyx_der_const_adjust_citic.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.der_const_adjust_citic WHERE con_date BETWEEN '${beg_date}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${beg_date}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
